items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update (Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account, leading to account takeover and access to private customer data. Adobe released isolated patches for this and six other vulnerabilities.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update (Stored Cross-Site Scripting)
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update (Stored Cross-Site Scripting)
items.summary: This high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could lead to arbitrary code execution. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Adobe Commerce B2B Security Update (Incorrect Authorization)
items.summary: An incorrect-authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update (Incorrect Authorization)
items.summary: This incorrect-authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass and requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update (Incorrect Authorization)
items.summary: An incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update (Incorrect Authorization)
items.summary: This incorrect-authorization vulnerability could result in privilege escalation. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento extension, allowing remote code execution via a crafted cookie. Mirasvit released a patched version (1.11.12) on May 25, 2026.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce via REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered PolyShell, a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that enables unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files disguised as images, bypassing validation. Adobe released Magento 2.4.9 with a fix, but older versions remain vulnerable without backports.
